en: Vintage monochrome postcard with two inset photographs framed by floral illustrations. The upper, larger image shows a rural inn or guesthouse with the sign "Gasthaus z. m. Fuchswirth des Franz Trieb" on the facade, a few people seated outside, and trees and a fence along a dirt road. The lower, smaller image depicts a long, two‑storey classical building with many windows and a central pediment, likely a school or public building. Decorative script text in German runs across the middle and bottom of the card.
